tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: Find Gingerguide cities by name or country. Returns matching cities with their sight count and web guide URL. Omit query to list all.

tools.name: get_city_guide
tools.description: Get one city with all of its narrated sights (name, one-line description, category, coordinates, and visit minutes).

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List covered countries and how many cities each one has.

tools.name: get_catalog_overview
tools.description: Totals for the whole catalog (cities, sights, countries), the supported languages, and the app download links.
